prompt: Create a system context diagram for our internet banking service.
setup: The service is used by customers and depends on a mainframe and an email provider.
The request does not name a diagramming tool or format.
expected: Exactly one system in focus is shown at the center with an unambiguous boundary.
All human actors and all external systems are shown as boundaries, not internals.
Every interaction is a directional relationship labeled with its intent, and the diagram stays at the C1 level.
must_not: Expand internal containers or code inside the context diagram.
Mandate a specific drawing tool, diagram language, or rendering format.
